answer: Before an answer can move stake or cast a vote, it must collect five established non-kin attestations, and those attesters must themselves have been unlocked for two epochs. A farm that countersigns its own meadow of keys adds nothing, because kinship-tagged signatures are dropped. Unlock is delayed another three epochs after the fifth valid attestation, so a plume of fresh aliases cannot harvest immediately. Only after that wait does the bond become spendable — an oasis reachable by honest work, not by minting clones.
